itinerary.title: La Trinidad: Strawberry Fields, Mountain Views & Garden Retreats (7-Day Budget Escape)
itinerary.description: Discover the 'Strawberry Capital of the Philippines' on this 7-day adventure. Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture, breathtaking nature, and delicious local flavors of La Trinidad, from blooming rose gardens to scenic mountain hikes, all while staying within a comfortable budget.

activities.notes: Start your day with a hearty Filipino breakfast like tapsilog or longsilog. Expect to pay around ₱100-₱120.
Take a jeepney from Km 5 (town proper) going towards Baguio (e.g., 'Plaza', 'Camp 7', 'Aurora Hill' routes) and alight at Bell Church. Fare is ₱15.

activities.activity: Explore the serene Bell Church complex
activities.notes: Wander through the beautifully intricate Taoist temple, admire the pagodas, and enjoy the tranquil gardens. Entry is free, but a small donation of ₱50 is welcome.
From Bell Church, it's a short 5-10 minute walk to the 'Colors of Stobosa' mural art project. Enjoy the vibrant houses overlooking the valley.
Find a local carinderia or 'turo-turo' (point-point) restaurant for an affordable and authentic Filipino meal. Budget around ₱180 per meal.
Take a jeepney from Km 3 back to Km 5. Fare is ₱15.

activities.activity: Browse local shops and enjoy a coffee break
activities.notes: Explore the commercial area. Grab a coffee or a local snack like 'palitaw' or 'kutsinta' from a street vendor or small café. Budget ₱120 for coffee/snack.
Indulge in their famous sizzling sisig or an affordable steak. A hearty meal will cost around ₱250.
A short jeepney ride if your accommodation is a bit further from Km 5. Fare is ₱15.
Another local breakfast to fuel your day. Budget ₱100.

activities.activity: Travel to La Trinidad Strawberry Farm
activities.notes: From Km 5, take a short jeepney ride (e.g., 'Betag' route) or walk if your accommodation is nearby. Fare is ₱15.

activities.activity: Explore the Strawberry Farm and try local treats
activities.notes: Walk through the strawberry fields, buy fresh produce, and don't miss trying strawberry taho or strawberry ice cream. Expect to spend around ₱100 for treats. Strawberry picking is an option (₱450-₱500/kg) if desired, but not included in this budget.
Enjoy a familiar meal at the world-famous fast-food chain, conveniently located in the heart of the commercial district. Budget around ₱200 for a meal.
Experience the bustling local market. Browse for fresh fruits, vegetables, and local delicacies. Budget ₱200 for small purchases/pasalubong.

activities.activity: Relax at a local park or cafe
activities.notes: Unwind after market shopping. Find a quiet spot or a cafe for some downtime. Budget ₱120 for a drink or light snack.
Try another local specialty. Many eateries offer affordable and delicious Filipino dishes. Budget ₱250 for dinner.
A quick jeepney ride if needed. Fare is ₱15.
Start your day with a budget-friendly breakfast, ₱100.
Take a jeepney from La Trinidad Public Market specifically going to 'Bahong'. Fare is ₱25.

activities.activity: Explore the 'Rose Capital of the Philippines'
activities.notes: Walk through vast terraces of blooming roses, chrysanthemums, and anthuriums. A minimal environmental fee or donation of ₱50 may be requested.

activities.activity: Lunch at a simple eatery in Bahong
activities.notes: Enjoy a simple and fresh meal in Bahong. Options might be limited, but you'll find carinderias offering home-cooked dishes. Budget ₱150.

activities.activity: Travel back to La Trinidad town proper
activities.notes: Take a jeepney from Bahong back to Km 5. Fare is ₱25.
Take a short walk around the BSU campus. You can visit their museum or gardens (if open) for a minimal fee of ₱50, or simply enjoy the academic atmosphere.
Grab a light snack or cold drink from a convenience store or street vendor. Budget ₱80.
Explore more local dining options. Try a different carinderia or a 'silog' (rice and egg) place for dinner. Budget ₱180.
Short jeepney ride, ₱15.
Have a quick and early breakfast to prepare for your hike. Buy some pandesal and coffee, or grab a packed meal. Budget ₱80.

activities.activity: Travel to Mount Kalugong jump-off point
activities.notes: Take a jeepney from Km 5 heading towards 'Puguis'. Alight at the Puguis junction. Fare is ₱20.

activities.activity: Tricycle ride to Mount Kalugong entrance
activities.notes: From Puguis junction, take a tricycle to the entrance of Mount Kalugong Eco-Park. Negotiate fare, around ₱60 (can be split if with others).
Enjoy the scenic hike up to the peak and explore the unique rock formations. Entrance fee is ₱100.

activities.activity: Coffee and snack with a view
activities.notes: Reward yourself with freshly brewed Benguet Arabica coffee and a slice of carrot cake while enjoying panoramic views of La Trinidad Valley. Budget ₱200.

activities.activity: Descend Mount Kalugong and travel back to town
activities.notes: Walk back down to the main road. Take a tricycle (₱60) back to Puguis junction, then a jeepney (₱20) to Km 5.
A satisfying late lunch after your morning hike. Budget ₱200.
Take some free time to rest after the physical activity or simply relax at a park.
Find another local spot for dinner, perhaps trying a different type of cuisine like a mami/pares house. Budget ₱220.
Short jeepney ride home, ₱15.
Quick and affordable local breakfast, ₱100.
Take a jeepney from Km 5 with the route 'Puguis-Buyagan-Longlong-Lamtang'. Ask the driver to drop you off at Mount Costa. Fare is ₱40.

activities.activity: Explore the enchanting gardens of Mount Costa
activities.notes: Spend hours wandering through 24 beautifully landscaped gardens, including the Mirror Garden and Zen Garden. Entrance fee is ₱350 per adult.
Enjoy a light and refreshing lunch at the cafe within Mount Costa. Budget around ₱250 for a meal and a drink.

activities.activity: Continue enjoying the gardens or relax
activities.notes: Revisit your favorite garden or find a quiet spot to simply relax and enjoy the serene environment.

activities.activity: Travel back to La Trinidad town
activities.notes: Take a jeepney from Mount Costa back to Km 5. Fare is ₱40.
Dine at one of the many local eateries offering various Filipino dishes. Budget ₱200.
A final jeepney ride for the day, ₱15.
Enjoy another budget-friendly breakfast, ₱100.

activities.activity: Travel to Lily of the Valley Organic Farms
activities.notes: Take a jeepney from Km 5 going towards 'Wangal'. Alight at the Wangal main road. Fare is ₱20.

activities.location: Lily of the Valley Organic Farms
activities.notes: From Wangal main road, take a tricycle to the organic farm. Negotiate fare, around ₱60.

activities.activity: Farm tour and learning about organic farming
activities.location: Lily of the Valley Organic Farms
activities.notes: Take a guided tour to learn about sustainable agriculture and organic farming practices. Entrance/tour fee is around ₱150.

activities.location: Lily of the Valley Organic Farms
activities.notes: Savor fresh, healthy, and organic produce directly from the farm. Budget ₱300 for a satisfying meal.

activities.activity: Relax and enjoy the farm surroundings
activities.location: Lily of the Valley Organic Farms
activities.notes: Spend some time enjoying the peaceful ambiance, perhaps try some fresh juices or browse their farm store.

activities.activity: Travel back to La Trinidad town
activities.notes: Take a tricycle (₱60) from the farm back to Wangal main road, then a jeepney (₱20) to Km 5.
Use this time for last-minute souvenir shopping or simply unwind.
Enjoy a final dinner, perhaps revisiting your favorite local eatery or trying something new. Budget ₱200.
Short jeepney ride home, ₱15.

activities.activity: Breakfast at a favorite local spot
activities.notes: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at your favorite carinderia or cafe. Budget ₱120.

activities.location: La Trinidad Public Market / Pasalubong Center
activities.notes: Stock up on souvenirs like strawberry jams, ube jam, peanut brittle, and local handicrafts. Budget ₱500 for various items.
Use this time to finalize packing and prepare for departure.
Have a satisfying last meal in La Trinidad. Budget ₱200.

Take a jeepney or taxi to your departure terminal. If heading to Baguio's main terminal, a jeepney from Km 5 is about ₱15-₱20, or a taxi around ₱80-₱120. Budget ₱30 for a jeepney to the main La Trinidad jeepney terminal if connecting elsewhere.

localTips: Always opt for jeepneys for inter-town travel. They are the cheapest and most authentic way to get around La Trinidad. Don't hesitate to ask locals or drivers for directions; they are generally very helpful.
While the Strawberry Farm is iconic, explore the La Trinidad Public Market for more budget-friendly strawberry products, local vegetables, and other 'pasalubong' (souvenirs/gifts).
Dress in layers. La Trinidad, like Baguio, has cool weather, especially in the mornings and evenings. A light jacket or sweater is advisable.
Bargaining is generally not common in established shops and jeepney fares are fixed, but if buying handicrafts or fresh produce in markets, a little friendly negotiation might be possible.
